provenance.standard: ISO 10628-1:2014 process diagrams for chemical and petrochemical industry

rules.description: Select and cite exact editions of the applicable equipment-symbol and instrument-symbol standards before resolving symbols.
Record source and target ports, flow direction, and the process, utility, electrical, pneumatic, or signal line class for every connector.
Preserve source-defined equipment and instrument tags exactly in both the node contract and symbol mapping.
Record named port roles for every tagged item connected by a process or signal line.
A live Draw.io MCP globe-valve result proves renderer availability only; validate the symbol against the selected P&ID standard.
